objective: Map the whole golf ground with geographically supported shapes, positions and object identities. Cover every requested category; do not equate visually plausible rendering with verified mapping.

categories.gap: Explicit OSM power supports and seven non-tree tagged points used. Unobserved procedural props suppressed; full small-object census and dimensions remain unverified.

50 municipal network-RTK tree positions (32 broadleaf, 18 conifer) retained as separate source observations. 4181 LiDAR crowns and 228 OSM points are not an additive stem census; identities and botanical species are unresolved.
30 individually traced range mats and seven tagged non-tree OSM objects mapped; benches, bins, signs and maintenance equipment still need visible evidence.

One 116.240 m2 practice path replaces the entire coarse w438967934 strip using reviewed municipal boundaries. 148 municipal road-edge observations retained separately; open edges do not establish closed paved areas. Other alignments, widths and hidden links remain incomplete.
Six outlines reviewed; other shorelines retain original provenance and topology uncertainties.
Terrain depressions alone do not establish trenches; no new candidate approved.

13 municipal ditch records reviewed: four new drainage lines (one surrounding-context line), nine existing corridors corroborated without duplicates. Widths, depths, flow and water permanence are unknown; no synthetic terrain carving adopted.

444 footprints retained, including 43 municipal adopted components/additions. 2026 Halfway House news and 7.2 x 6.4 m plan found, but no identifiable georeferenced as-built footprint; do not confuse other new municipal records with that house.
Target footprints do not establish material, poles, distances or individual machinery.
Four aggregate platform footprints and30 individual mats mapped. Surface interpretation and unknown vertical dimensions remain explicit.
NMDv2.0 supplies coarse broadleaf/conifer context, not individual species or new forest boundaries; newer v2.1 equivalence is unverified.
19 surveyed fence/hedge/wall boundary lines added as geographic observations, with unmeasured vertical geometry. No invented 3D fence details. Rock, sign and small-object coverage remains incomplete.

Four observed bridge footprints, including one additional municipal southern crossing, with exact horizontal geometry. Deck elevation, thickness, rails and southern approach connectivity remain unmeasured or unreviewed.
Seven existing mapped lots retained. Municipal parking-edge observations acquired for future polygon/topology review; no blind filling of open boundaries. Vehicles are transient.
Four reviewed greens retained. Museum Hamo report and club redevelopment plans add context; plans and historical excavation maps do not prove current completed construction.

148 municipal open edge records acquired; 120 are usable source observations and 28 have unknown method/50 m accuracy. Footway, carriageway and parking edges are not automatically filled as road polygons.
50 surveyed trees distinguish broadleaf/conifer only. Coarse woodland context and these leaf types do not identify botanical species.

Stora has 54 platform entries: 52 imagery outlines and two provisional originals (H13 and upper H15). H11 rear and Mellan H8 north added from wider archive review, with 2025 crosschecks. Mellan has 24 platforms; partial census and daily marker/colour gaps remain.

Remaining OSM rings retained, with small edge differences unaccepted. All nine Mellan greens have imagery or OSM outlines. Pin positions and absolute accuracy remain unverified.

All 86 OSM IDs tracked; H8 Sahara exposed sand added (85.98 m2) after 2024/2025 imagery and club-source review. Earlier practice/range/retirement corrections retained. Depth, movable rakes and remaining temporal changes are unverified.
Default rough shading does not count as a mapped mowing boundary.
Tagged landuse polygons retained; current crop and mowing class not verified.
A building footprint alone does not establish use as a cottage.
Seasonal tall-grass boundaries and height require dated evidence.

acceptance: Use terrain for shape, dated imagery for material and visible edges, explicit records for identity.
Retain original geometry and assert it before replacement; record source date, hash, frame and uncertainty.
Measure method performance against independent known objects where available; agreement is not absolute accuracy.
Preserve islands, narrow connections, polygon topology and actual terrain under observed mowing extents.
Update both courses, GIS export, routing/pack bindings and checksum registries after accepted changes.
Commit each substantial completed improvement; completeSurvey remains false while any category has unverified coverage.
mappingStatus: Reviewed improvements adopted; incomplete categories remain explicit and must not be filled with invented geometry.
